import re
from collections import Counter

_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z']+")


def top_words(text: str, k: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    """Return the ``k`` most common words in ``text``.

    A word is a maximal run of ASCII letters and apostrophes, so ``"don't"`` is one word
    and ``"well-known"`` is two. Counting is case-insensitive and words are returned
    lowercased, sorted by count descending and then alphabetically.
    """
    counts = Counter(word.lower() for word in _WORD_RE.findall(text))
    return sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:k]
